title: Turn a Long Email Thread Into a Verified Action List With AI
description: Stop asking AI for vague email summaries. Turn a long thread into a draft decision log with the decision, owner, due date, source sentence and open questions. Remove unnecessary personal or confidential details first, mark missing information as “not specified,” and verify every row against the original messages. A suggestion is not an approved decision. Keep the result as a draft until a person checks it. Professor Mia teaches practical AI workflows for work.
pinned_comment: Which part of your inbox would you turn into a verified action list first?
